expectations.text: Justifies going native via concrete mobile needs (installed app, push notifications) rather than vibes

expectations.text: Warns a rebuild is required and explains why the rebuild is easier than the first build

expectations.text: Prescribes flow-by-flow rebuild (map flows, per-flow specs) instead of one-shot regeneration
